svg.title: A RESTART that never arrives
svg.desc: The station arms a restart to B and sends RESTART, which is lost. No answer comes and the client times out. The next beacon, 42, counts up at the default interval with the flag clear, which says the RESTART was not taken. Nothing on the ground is held back: a START_NODE goes and is acted on. The station sends RESTART again with the same key while the arm still stands; it is taken, and beacon 43 carries the flag.
